units.source_text: 阿姐本来是要嫁到那家店铺去的，后来她改变了主意，突然吹了，闹了好一阵子。

en.t: She was originally supposed to marry into that shop, but then she changed her mind and suddenly called it off, causing quite a commotion for a while.

units.source_text: 人家好容易特地为她盖了房子，临要出嫁时她就把人家甩掉了。

en.t: They had gone to all the trouble of building a house especially for her, and just when she was about to marry, she threw them over.

units.source_text: 因为她另有所爱，并打算同那人结婚呢。

en.t: It was because she loved someone else and meant to marry him.

units.source_text: 一个人一着了迷，就会弄成那个样子吗？

en.t: Is that what happens when a person becomes infatuated?

units.source_text: 据说，对方已经逃跑，如今她又不能破镜重圆，把那间店铺要回来，

en.t: They say the man has already run away, and now she cannot go back and make things as they were, asking for that shop again,

units.source_text: 也不好意思再呆在那里，所以只好到别的地方另起炉灶了。

en.t: and she is too ashamed to stay there any longer, so she has no choice but to start over somewhere else.
When you think about it, it really is pitiful.

units.source_text: 我们虽然知道得不多，可是她的确也碰到过形形色色的人啊。”

en.t: We did not know much about it, but she certainly had dealings with all sorts of people.”
